states.digest_assertion: each state digest asserted against logs/frozenbb1/births.jsonl before it is read

constant_rule: s_l = geometric mean of RMS_l(delta_bp) over the six FROZEN states for l in 4..7 (arena) and over the six FULL states for l in 0..7 (full stack); booked regardless of the trigger

health: HEALTHY iff nonfinite_elements == 0 and zero_token_norms == 0 on every inspected block of every state
